locations.name: Corva
locations.description: A red dwarf at the end of a minor lane, with one giant worth the trip.

children.name: Gall
children.description: The gas giant. Banded ochre and bruise; its cloud-tops are skimmed for deuterium and helium-three.

children.name: The Deep
children.description: Gall below the cloud deck: thousands of kilometres of crushing heat. Dippers give their dead to it.

children.name: Platform Four
children.description: A Halloran-Vey skimmer platform, derelict in high Gall orbit for five centuries.

children.name: Kettle
children.description: Gall's ice moon: a cracked white shell over a black ocean.

children.name: Kettle Camp
children.description: The Combine's warrens in the ice, where two thousand bonded families process what the Patience brings up.

children.name: Patience
children.description: The city under Kettle's ice, grown around the sunken hull of the old skimmer.

children.name: The Spine
children.description: The old hull of the Patience, standing in the ice: Council nave, archive, docks.

children.name: The Ninth Tier
children.description: An upper warren of the unshared, close under the surface ice; cold, poor, thin of air.

children.name: The Archive
children.description: Malachy Orr's archive in the Spine's old cargo decks.

children.name: The Cells
children.description: Prison levels under the Spine.

children.name: South Lock
children.description: The city's southern surface lock.

children.name: The Rime
children.description: Old surface shelters on Kettle's ice, abandoned since the founding: thin domes, no heat.

children.name: The Patience
children.description: Halloran-Vey skimmer-refinery, 1.2 km of ugly: a tether drum like a cathedral, a 40 km line, and the Bucket on the end of it.

children.name: The tether deck
children.description: Control gallery over the drum, where the tether-chief runs the line.

children.name: The Drum
children.description: The tether drum hall, big enough to hold the whole crew; assemblies happen here.

children.name: The Belly
children.description: The hollow under the drum: maintenance void, secret meeting place.

children.name: The infirmary
children.description: Ekene Adu's infirmary.

children.name: The blister
children.description: Observation blister on the Patience's dorsal hull.

children.name: The factor's cabin
children.description: Company quarters near the bridge.

children.name: The bridge
children.description: The Patience's bridge.

children.name: The Clement
children.description: Combine supply ship that brings Factor Quist.

children.name: The cold hold
children.description: Cryogenic cargo hold of the Clement.

children.name: The Admonition
children.description: Combine escort cutter: marines and torpedoes.

children.name: The Lamp
children.description: The comet. Resonant with Gall; comes round every two hundred and sixty-odd years.

children.name: The black ridge
children.description: A dark carbon ridge on the Lamp's south limb.

children.name: The chamber
children.description: A room cut in the Lamp's ice, forty metres down.

children.name: The Throat
children.description: Mouth of the lane to the rest of human space, near Gall's trailing Trojan point.

children.name: The Gull
children.description: Scoop-tug of the Patience.

children.name: The Wick
children.description: A dipper skiff of Patience, fitted out for the Lamp Run.

children.name: The Dray
children.description: Til Brask's salvage tug: old, armoured, slow, unkillable.

children.name: The Carrion Hymn
children.description: Mother Szabo's armed repossession ship.

locations.name: Tarn
locations.description: A poor system of debt and docks, two lanes from Corva.

children.name: Cinderhaven
children.description: Tarn's ring-station, all ledgers and repossession yards.

children.name: Szabo's counting-house
children.description: Mother Szabo's house of paper on Cinderhaven's Ledger Ring.

children.name: Dock Nine
children.description: Where the Dray is berthed and about to be seized.
